title: Semantic Ranking Validator Lab: multi-domain golden sets and drift sentinels
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a reusable evaluation harness (the 'Validator Lab') that can: 1) host multiple domain-specific golden sets and fast synthetic perturbations, 2) run offline ranking metrics and stability checks across model and quantization variants, and 3) produce drift signals and actionable alerts for reranker/embedding regressions. This ticket focuses on the core harness, dataset curation workflows, and the first rule-based drift detector. The harness should be modular so downstream teams can plug in new metrics (MRR, P@k, NDCG, rank correlation, embedding stability) and new data sources (production replays, customer contrived examples, nightly synthetic generators).
acceptance_criteria:
- Validator Lab can run a configurable job over 5 domain golden sets and produce a results artifact (CSV/JSON) with: MRR@10, P@1/5/10, KendallTau, pairwise flip rate, and mean cosine drift score.
- Baseline run against current prod embeddings completes end-to-end within a scheduled job (<= 45m for 50k pairs on the nightly infra).
- Canary workflow launches a rerank variant to 5% traffic when a selected metric regresses > 6% relative change and includes automated dashboard update + PagerDuty alert test.
- Results include per-query examples of top regressions and PR links for follow-up triage.
- Unit & integration tests cover synthetic perturbation injection and metric calculators.
design_decisions:
- Use a hybrid golden-set approach: human-curated anchors for high-precision signal + stratified sampled production queries for recall coverage.
- Metric set chosen to balance production needs (MRR/P@k) and signal quality (Kendall Tau + flip rate).
- Compute path: embedding vector ops in Rust service for speed, orchestration in Airflow/Luigi and results stored in S3.
- Drift detector uses sliding-window bootstrap and an exponential decay baseline to surface acute regressions while being robust to steady seasonal shifts.
- Canary gating kept conservative (5% traffic, 30-minute evaluation window) to avoid user-visible regressions.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for metric functions (edge cases, identical embeddings, zero-length queries).
- Integration tests: run harness against synthetic suite (typos, paraphrase, adversarial synonyms) and validate expected metric deltas.
- Load test: run 50k pair offline job on nightly cluster and confirm completion under 45 minutes and <10% variance run-to-run.
- Canary dry-run: simulate traffic split in staging and verify telemetry, trace continuity (trace IDs pass through reranker), and rollback path.
- Alerting tests: deliberate metric regression injected (flip threshold) to confirm PagerDuty + Slack notifications and runbook link.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge harness code + metrics; dry-run on staging with synthetic sets. 2) Create first five domain golden sets (search, support KB, e-commerce catalog, legal QA, enterprise docs). 3) Nightly job for baseline collection for two weeks to compute stable baselines. 4) Enable canary gating for rerank v2 at 5% for 2h windows with automated evaluation. 5) Iterate on thresholds and false-positive suppression rules for two cycles before promoting to alerting and pagerduty.
open_questions:
- What is the long-term storage policy for golden set annotations and per-run artifacts? (S3 prefix vs. internal DB)
- Should drift signals be integrated into the Console as a first-class timeline or remain in engineering dashboards?
- Do we expose per-customer golden sets for high-TAM enterprise customers, and what access controls are required?
- Performance: can the Rust embedding op library be safely used in the nightly cluster (dependencies & CVEs)?
- How to harmonize canonical tokenization differences between model variants when computing embedding cosine?
